headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 1, 2026**
article:
The Baltimore Orioles secured a convincing 6-1 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Dean Kremer earning the win. In other action, the Cleveland Guardians dominated the Texas Rangers 9-4 behind Austin Hedges' 3-RBI, 2-homer performance and Joey Cantillo's 5-inning start. The Washington Nationals routed the Boston Red Sox 10-2, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The Detroit Tigers took down the New York Yankees 6-2, with Keider Montero earning the win.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Matt Chapman, the San Francisco Giants' third baseman, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. Kris Bubic, a left-hander for the Kansas City Royals, has been placed on the 60-day injured list with left elbow soreness. Other injured players include Corey Seager (Texas Rangers), Will Vest (Detroit Tigers), Connelly Early (Boston Red Sox), Anthony Bender (Miami Marlins), and Jeremy Peña (Houston Astros).

The Washington Nationals have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of right-hander Kyle Nicolas, acquired from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for shortstop Randal Diaz. The Nationals' roster has also been impacted by the trade. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples. The San Francisco Giants traded 1B Buddy Kennedy to the Seattle Mariners for cash.
